author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The legal audit has confirmed that our loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, which breaks the legal basis for using it in forecasts. I am setting a hard line on this. I will not accept any data into the pipeline unless the data contracts are fully governed. This means formal sign off from the compliance team is mandatory before a single scan line is processed. There is no manual review exception. If the contracts are not formally approved, the data is rejected. I am not interested in workarounds that delay the promotion planning cycle. The compliance gate must be closed and verified before we proceed with any further integration.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly establishes a non-negotiable rule that data without formal compliance sign-off is rejected, with no exceptions or workarounds, defining a strict line whose crossing constitutes refusal.
